facades.name: Hexagon & Blanco · photo facade
facades.notes: 29 May 2022 exterior photograph. Exact City south-wall endpoints and its measured sloping parapet tops bound this partial upper-wall crop. The 2012 source shell remains unchanged; it is not proof that every 2022 height is exact. The lower crop cuts at the visible Blanco sign/trim and balcony band, not ground; its local base3.2 m is an architectural correspondence estimate. Projective mapping follows the measured trapezoid instead of stretching a rectangle above the east parapet. Ground and the partly car-obscured lower frontage are excluded. Bare branches, railing and a lamp remain photographic occlusions. Only this observed south plane receives a plain white/windowless material underneath, preventing invented generic windows above or below the photo.

registration.method: measured City south wall and endpoint parapet tops; manually identified partial photographic upper-wall band
registration.heightMethod: Top endpoints 8.32 m west / 6.48 m east are actual source wall vertices. The visible lower crop is an upper-storey/Blanco sign-and-trim band, estimated at local y3.2 m using its correspondence with the sloping parapet and approximately horizontal window/trim features. It is not an observed ground line or a surveyed camera pose.
registration.sourceDateMeaning: City DATE_ record field; acquisition date not independently verified

previousVerticalEstimate.issue: The partial upper-wall photograph was compressed down to ground level, leaving false generic upper windows above it.
